posts.text:
Tonight, I secured a key concession from the Trump admin to close a loophole in the Russia sanctions bill that expanded Trump’s tariff power. 

This is a small but important victory for all Americans who have suffered under this President’s reckless tariffs.
posts.summary: Secured tariff restrictions, criticizes Trump's tariff policy as reckless

posts.text:
61 years ago, the Voting Rights Act became law thanks to the hard work and perseverance of civil rights activists. 
 
This year, Trump’s Supreme Court gutted it. They are playing with the blood of our ancestors. 
 
Honor their legacy. Pass the John Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act.
posts.summary: Condemns Supreme Court gutting of Voting Rights Act, calls for restoration

I just voted to end President Trump's war in Iran.

This reckless and illegal war has left us worse off. It has been a failure of leadership to the highest degree.
